The claim (VERBATIM, do not rephrase): GSE is the first system to surpass a minimal combination of FOUR criteria, cracking the brittleness barrier in classical/GOFAI computational NLP for a scoped subset (sentence-level, "see spot run" tier). (3) Cheap/efficient — binary modality, laptop-scale vs nation-state compute. (4) Resolve statements of truth beyond the literal encoding — arbitrary "x than y" without regex or hand-coding past the basic rule. The "smoking gun for an architecture that can crack the hard problem of GOFAI."</current_goal>
